coverage.notes: The validated Invoke branch forwards original Plan through JSON token crawl helpers. ReturnItemSignal below the branch return is unreachable and excluded; dynamic token lookups target ItemSignal content or other adapters, not incoming Plan children.

properties.description: Forward the configuration object into a constructed token lookup plan.

evidence.trace: Original Plan passes through Invoke-TokenCrawl and Resolve-TokenForProperty. The helper resolves Config and copies it to TokenPlan.Config. Its apparent Resolve-ClonePlan call is inside a block comment and excluded.
evidence.condition: Invoke when token matching reaches the adapter-lookup branch in Resolve-TokenForProperty.

properties.description: Select deferred token delimiters when the style is Deferred.

evidence.trace: The JSON token helper receives original Plan and resolves HydrationStyle without a supplied Default, then forwards the style into crawling.
evidence.condition: Invoke after source Path resolution succeeds.

properties.description: Locate source content in ItemSignal for token substitution and writeback.

evidence.trace: Original Path is read by the class and again by Invoke-JsonTokenCondenser line 26; actual target data lives in ItemSignal.
evidence.condition: Map Invoke, subject to preceding resolver success.

coverage.notes: When incoming Plan is non-null it aliases ProposalSignal and, in Template mode, Proposal. If Plan is null, fallback comes from ItemSignal and is not attributed as incoming Plan. @. paths retain their Signal payload-root semantics. The branch comment says not currently functional; this inventory documents actual reads without runtime acceptance.

properties.description: Select Direct or Template mapping from the incoming proposal signal payload.

evidence.trace: Map passes the exact non-null incoming Plan as ProposalSignal. Resolver path @.CondenserMode dereferences that incoming signal payload; retain @. rather than flattening it. Missing/blank mode becomes Direct by code, not resolver Default.
evidence.condition: Map with non-null incoming Plan whose ProposalSignal.HasResult() succeeds.

properties.description: Read the incoming proposal signal payload content for direct substitution.

evidence.trace: Direct mode receives original Plan as ProposalSignal and resolves literal @.Content. Its payload is therefore derived from original Plan; @. is retained.
evidence.condition: Map Direct mode with a non-null incoming proposal signal.

properties.description: Select the direct-substitution tag format from the proposal signal payload.

evidence.trace: Direct helper resolves @.ReplacementType without Default; local initial AtAt is not a resolver-supplied fallback.
evidence.condition: Map Direct mode after content resolution succeeds.

properties.description: Validate template content, derive tags and return substituted content.

evidence.trace: Invoke-MapCondenser passes original non-null Plan as Proposal directly in Template mode (line 41). These are direct members of that same object; unlike Direct mode, no @. dereference is implied. Reads after replacement may see locally modified Content.
evidence.condition: Map Template mode with non-null incoming Plan and successful proposal/content checks; loop-member reads require matching tags and relay sources.
